title: Keto Middle Eastern Lamb Kibbeh
description: A keto twist on traditional Middle Eastern lamb kibbeh, featuring a crispy exterior and flavorful interior.

ingredients.name: Middle eastern spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground lamb, Middle eastern spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Add the bulgur to the lamb mixture and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
Crack in the eggs and mix until the mixture is just holding together.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the eastern olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the patties to the skillet and fry until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the kibbeh to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kibbeh is baking, crumble the briny feta cheese into small pieces and set aside.
Once the kibbeh is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kibbeh hot, topped with crumbled feta cheese and any other desired toppings.
